03

Research Interpretation

What this layer contributes to the major project.

Multi-model integration

Brings independently trained disease modules into one user-level intelligence view without merging their predictions into an unsupported diagnosis.

Longitudinal context

Separates current model output from within-disease change over repeated assessments.

Shared-factor transparency

Shows where recorded inputs overlap across modules while preserving differences in feature meaning and thresholds.

Research & safety note: This page summarizes outputs from this project's machine-learning models and rule-based attention logic. It does not diagnose disease, estimate combined clinical risk, establish causation, or replace evaluation by a qualified healthcare professional.
